title: I Don't Love You
lyrics:
[00:26.16]Well, when you go
[00:31.29]Don't ever think I'll make you try to stay
[00:37.69]And maybe when you get back
[00:40.60]I'll be off to find another way
[00:48.35]And after all this time that you still owe
[00:53.99]You're still a good-for-nothing, I don't know
[01:00.29]So take your gloves and get out
[01:03.72]Better get out while you can
[01:13.30]When you go
[01:17.30]And would you even turn to say
[01:23.69]"I don't love you like I did yesterday"?
[01:33.85]Sometimes, I cry so hard from pleading
[01:39.85]So sick and tired of all the needless beating
[01:45.52]But baby, when they knock you down and out
[01:50.54]Is where you oughta stay
[01:56.06]And after all the blood that you still owe
[02:01.78]Another dollar's just another blow
[02:08.00]So fix your eyes and get up
[02:11.56]Better get up while you can
[02:16.54]Whoa, whoa, whoa
[02:21.17]When you go
[02:25.08]And would you even turn to say
[02:31.42]"I don't love you like I did yesterday"?
[02:40.54]Well, come on, come on
[03:06.24]When you go
[03:10.52]Would you have the guts to say
[03:16.63]"I don't love you like I loved you yesterday"? (Oh, oh)
[03:27.89]I don't love you like I loved you yesterday
[03:39.21]I don't love you like I loved you yesterday
